{{Top|leg}}
'''Renegade''' was a term used to describe the citizens of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] who went underground, during the Imperial occupation of the planet following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Those beings lived by stealing and pillaging, and were in constant conflict with the [[Scavenger/Legends|Scavs]].
